fact: ANSI says Niger is engaged in the progressive deployment of a national E-Cadastre, steered by the newly installed CONPEC, with ANSI building the NIPU parcel-identification platform as its infrastructure.
The Ministry of Urbanism and Habitat reports a 16 September 2025 meeting ending with recommendations to accelerate the digitalisation of the cadastre in Niger.
The Minister chaired a meeting on the E-Cadastre project, run with ANSI, which aims to set up a national digital cadastral system; a steering committee is to be created.

The minister of urbanism and housing said a single cadastre is being built through the E-Cadastre project developed with ANSI and financed by the World Bank PVI, with cadastral digitalisation the priority.
